changelog:
Version 2026.10.09-1  (Oct 9, 2026)
  • Controlling replaces Amecs: search your keys and spot clashes in Controls. Epic Fight fix: no more crash with the Vatansever's finisher.
  • Updated options.txt
  • Added Controlling 19.0.5
  • Added Epic Fight 21.17.3.1
  • Removed Amecs 1.6.3+mc1.21.1
  • Removed Epic Fight 21.17.3.1
  • Changed 16 config files

Version 2026.10.07-2  (Oct 7, 2026)
  • Simply Entity Equipment is now in the pack too, so solo worlds match the server: monsters can spawn with swords and armor, and they get tougher the farther you travel from spawn.
  • Added Simply Entity Equipment 0.1.0-1.21.1

Version 2026.10.07-1  (Oct 7, 2026)
  • New launcher 1.3.0: a Controls page lists every key with what it does, shows clashing keys in red, and sets the new Alantria layout with one click (your old keys are backed up). New players start with that layout: combat, parkour, spells and abilities under your left hand, menus on the right. Removed WTHIT: Jade already shows the block you're looking at, so you saw two bars.
  • Updated options.txt
  • Removed wthit 12.10.2

Version 2026.10.05-2  (Oct 5, 2026)
  • New weapons, armor and bosses: Simply Swords, Simply More and Simply Bows, Epic Knights (medieval armor and weapons, with Epic Fight moves), and L_Ender's Cataclysm (huge boss fights). Tip: give the game at least 10 GB of memory in Settings (12 GB if your PC has 32 GB).
  • Added efweaponscompat-1.0.0
  • Added epic-knights-1.21.1-neoforge-10.16
  • Added lionfishapi-3.1
  • Added L_Ender's Cataclysm 1.21.1-3.33
  • Added SimplyBows-neoforge-0.1.4-1.21.1
  • Added simplymore-neoforge-1.3.0_alpha5+1.21.1
  • Added simplyswords-neoforge-1.70.2-1.21.1
  • Added SimplyTooltips-neoforge-0.1.5

Version 2026.10.05-1  (Oct 5, 2026)
  • Dragon Survival's choice screen no longer appears when you join; default memory raised to 10 GB
  • Changed 6 config files

Version 2026.10.03-1  (Oct 3, 2026)
  • Updated NeoForge to 21.1.250; removed RPG Series (Wizards, Paladins, Rogues, Archers, Armory, Arsenal, Jewelry, Relics, Runes, Gazebos, Spell Engine, Spell Power)

test.name: Dao Ascendant test build
test.notes:
Dao Ascendant test build 0.1.0-test2
  • New controls: tap R to use your Dao ability, hold R for the ability wheel. K opens the cultivation menu. In the launcher, open Controls and press Apply Alantria layout for the whole new key layout (your old keys are backed up).
  • Merchants and healers now turn you away when your aura is Demonic. A Concealment Talisman hides it.
  • /dao set @s lotus 9 now unlocks the lotus skills right away.
  • Sneak + use on the Spirit Gathering Array (tribulation), the Ascension Altar and parkour checkpoints now works with items in your hands.
  • Townsfolk appear within 2 seconds when you reach a great city.
  • Set Memory to at least 10 GB in Settings (12 GB if your PC has 32 GB).
  • This tab installs the whole Alantria pack plus Dao Ascendant into its own folder, for SOLO worlds. It never joins the server.
  • Create a new Survival world with Allow Cheats ON. The Tester guide (book button, top right) explains how the mod plays and what to test.
  • Placeholder art: judge the mechanics, not the looks.
  • If the game crashes, the launcher offers to send a crash report: please say yes.
